exploratory.finding: class-weighted models have prior-shifted probabilities; single-parameter temperature scaling cannot correct that, so gate G2 (log loss below the training prior) fails mechanically. Elkan prior correction is applied to the log-loss ONLY; decisions are the model's argmax decisions as pre-registered.
